scope: England only. Scotland (STV) and Wales are out of scope for this cut. Councils are those in data/identity/councils-2027.json: the verified English councils, and the unverified ones as a separate, flagged block (block: "unverified").

field_notes.boundaries: current: May 2026 ONS wards, no order changes them for 2027. altered_2027: a May 2026 ward that a related-alteration order changes by a small parish-led area transfer from 2027. new: an Electoral Changes Order redraws the council's wards or divisions from the 2027 ordinary elections; names and councillors come from its schedule and there is no ONS code yet. unknown: the ward set could not be read.
field_notes.seats_up_basis: elected_2023_same_ward: winners at the 2023 ordinary poll in the same ward, whose terms end in 2027. elected_2019_same_ward_code: all-out council, winners in the same ONS ward code in 2019, kept only where the council's wards sum to its sourced total. order_schedule_all_out: councillors per ward in the 2027 order, all-out council. order_retirement_2027: the order that drew the current wards says how many of each ward's councillors retire in 2027. blank_total_mismatch / blank_2019_unreconciled: a figure was found but did not reconcile, so it is withheld. null: not established.
